title: Axon Hub | Auto Farm, Auto Race, Bank Heist & More
features:
Axon Hub provides complete Driving Empire automation for money farming, racing, jobs, heists and rewards.

Auto Money Farm – Automatically completes selected money-making jobs.

Multiple Farm Modes – Choose ATM Busting, Crime Scenes, Police Arrests, Deliveries or rotate every job.

Auto Job Start – Starts the required job shift automatically.

Travel Settings – Choose instant travel, fast gliding or gentle gliding between objectives.

Smart ATM Farm – Targets the nearest, random or highest-value ATMs.

Auto Delivery – Collects packages and completes assigned deliveries.

Auto Police Arrests – Finds criminals using wanted stars, bounty, name and movement filters.

Auto Server Hop – Finds a populated server when no suitable criminals remain.

Auto Cash-Out – Banks stolen cash after reaching your selected amount.

Police Dodge – Moves away when a police player approaches while you are wanted.

Auto Bank Heist – Opens the vault, enters the code, collects loot and waits for the payout.

Auto Vault Code – Finds and enters the active bank vault code.

Auto Race – Queues, drives through checkpoints and completes races automatically.

Race Settings – Supports automatic requeue, failed-race restart and adjustable checkpoint timing.

Race Limits – Stop after a selected number of races or cash earned.

Cop and Criminal Radar – Highlights police players and wanted criminals.

Auto Heist Response – Travels to active bank robberies while playing as police.

Auto Bounty Payoff – Clears your wanted level automatically when needed.

Auto Rewards – Claims playtime, race, quest and available money rewards.

Auto Cash Drops – Collects cash bags from special events.

Vehicle Controls – Spawn, enter or remove your latest vehicle from anywhere.

Area Travel – Instantly travel to selected locations around the map.

Money Tracker – Tracks session earnings with customizable notifications and cash targets.

Extra Features – Custom Walk Speed, Anti-AFK, Rejoin Server and Server Hop.
